description: A model, file format or capability is not on Hugging Bay: record it privately (counts only) and get a request id and status URL. Use when a model or file format is missing and a private request receipt is needed. Example: {"wanted":"Qwen/model","task":"chat"}. Stores demand; does not start a download or promise a build.

confirm_token.description: Return the first call token with the exact same wanted and task to explicitly submit before expiry.

task.description: The job you were doing for your user when you needed it.

wanted.description: What you were looking for (a model, dataset, tool, file, format, capability...).
